story.title: The Spirit of the Manufacture
story.intro: Every creation is conceived as an encounter between artisanal heritage, noble materials and contemporary rigour.
story.paragraph1: For fifteen years, L'Écrin Français has accompanied the finest collector's pieces with a discreet and precise approach. Every case is designed to reveal the value of what it holds.
story.paragraph2: Our savoir-faire brings together the soul of Burgundian craftsmanship and the rigour of a manufacture in Portugal, with total control over material, finish and detail.
story.paragraph3: Today, we place this hidden elegance at the service of a more intimate, more fluid and more singular experience.
story.imageCaption: Noble materials, meticulous finishing and constant attention to detail.

card1.title: Full-Circle Craftsmanship
card1.text: No intermediaries. From selecting the tree to fitting the last hinge, every detail is considered to endure and to seduce.

card2.title: The Art of Bespoke
card2.text: Millimetre-precise dimensions, hot stamping or laser engraving: we give shape to your most exacting ideas.

card3.title: From a Single Piece to a Series
card3.text: A single piece or a limited series, every order follows the same exacting standard of beauty and rigour.
